environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode). The ELB performs health checks on /healthz but does not inspect HTTP traffic. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional proxy or filtering layer between clients and the Flask application. The application is accessed directly via the ELB's DNS name on port 8080.

config.load_balancer: AWS Classic ELB in TCP passthrough mode
